_comment: Emulator configuration OWNED BY THE ADMIN PANEL's test suite. The repo's
root firebase.json is untracked, currently names an unrelated production
project, and is deliberately not touched by anything here.
Ports differ from the root config so the panel suite and the rules suite
There is no 'indexes' key because nothing in the panel needs a composite
index: every query either aggregates with count() (no ordering) or orders
and filters on FieldPath.documentId(), which uses the always-present
__name__ index. If a future metric adds a field filter, declare it in a
firestore.indexes.json next to this file and point an 'indexes' key here.
No 'rules' key: firebase-tools refuses a rules path outside the config's
own directory, and copying firestore.rules in here would create a second
copy that could drift from the real one. The suite instead installs the
REAL ../firestore.rules into the running emulator at test time, through the
emulator's own REST endpoint, reusing firebase_test/emulator.mjs's
loadRules(). The panel itself uses the Admin SDK, which bypasses rules
entirely and therefore needs no rule of its own.
